forums.name: Stock Broker / Trading Member Grievance Cell

description.en: Every SEBI-registered stock broker has a designated Grievance Officer and dedicated email address for resolving investor disputes.
description.hi: प्रत्येक सेबी-पंजीकृत स्टॉक ब्रोकर के पास निवेशक विवादों को सुलझाने के लिए एक नामित शिकायत अधिकारी और ईमेल आईडी होती है।
description.mr: प्रत्येक सेबी-नोंदणीकृत स्टॉक ब्रोकरकडे गुंतवणूकदारांचे वाद सोडवण्यासाठी एक नियुक्त तक्रार निवारण अधिकारी असतो.

requiredDocuments: Contract notes for disputed trade(s)
Demat account holding statement / Client Master Report (CMR)
Bank account statement showing funds transfer
Screenshots of trading platform error or dispute
Email / ticket correspondence with broker customer care

escalationSteps.title: Email Designated Grievance Officer
escalationSteps.action: Write directly to grievance@[brokername].com with transaction IDs and contract notes.

escalationSteps.title: Escalate to Stock Exchange (NSE / BSE)
escalationSteps.action: Lodge a complaint on NSE Investor Grievance Portal (https://www.nseindia.com) or BSE e-Complaint.

escalationSteps.title: Escalate to SEBI SCORES 2.0 & SMART ODR
escalationSteps.action: Lodge complaint on SEBI SCORES portal (https://scores.sebi.gov.in) or initiate conciliation on SMART ODR (https://smartodr.in).

forums.name: Depository Investor Grievance Cell (NSDL / CDSL)

description.en: Handles disputes relating to demat holding accounts, transmission of shares, pledged shares, and depository participant (DP) service failures.
description.hi: डीमैट खाता होल्डिंग, शेयरों का हस्तांतरण, गिरवी रखे शेयर और डीपी सेवा संबंधी विवादों के निवारण हेतु।
description.mr: डीमॅट खात्यातील शेअर्स, शेअर्सचे ट्रान्समिशन, तारण शेअर्स आणि डिपॉझिटरी पार्टिसिपंट सेवा त्रुटींच्या निवारणासाठी.

applicableIssues: transmission of shares of deceased holder
unauthorized pledge or unpledge of shares
wrong ISIN credit or corporate action delay
dp refusing to close demat account
requiredDocuments: Client Master Report (CMR) stamped by DP
Transaction Statement showing depository transfers
Delivery Instruction Slip (DIS) copy or e-DIS confirmation
Death certificate / Succession Certificate (for transmission cases)
Written communication with Depository Participant

escalationSteps.title: Submit to NSDL / CDSL Investor Relations
escalationSteps.action: Email relations@nsdl.co.in or lodge online on NSDL Grievance Portal.

escalationSteps.title: Escalate to Depository Member Dispute Committee
File on SEBI SCORES 2.0
escalationSteps.action: Lodge formal complaint on https://scores.sebi.gov.in mentioning the DP and Depository.

forums.name: SEBI Complaints Redress System (SCORES 2.0)
forums.source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

description.en: Centralized online platform by SEBI for grievances against listed companies and registered intermediaries (brokers, RTAs, mutual funds, research analysts, investment advisers).
description.hi: सूचीबद्ध कंपनियों और सेबी-पंजीकृत मध्यस्थों के खिलाफ शिकायतों के लिए सेबी का केंद्रीय ऑनलाइन मंच।
description.mr: नोंदणीकृत मध्यस्थ (ब्रोकर्स, म्युच्युअल फंड्स, ॲडव्हायझर्स) आणि लिस्टेड कंपन्यांविरोधात तक्रारींसाठी सेबीचे अधिकृत पोर्टल.

applicableIssues: dividend not paid by listed company
requiredDocuments: PAN Card details (mandatory on SCORES)
Proof of prior complaint to the broker / entity with ticket number
Account statements and payment proof
All email responses from the entity showing unresolved status
Contract notes or investment agreement copies

escalationSteps.title: Lodge Complaint on SCORES 2.0 Portal
escalationSteps.action: Register on https://scores.sebi.gov.in or SCORES Mobile App and select entity category.

escalationSteps.title: Entity Action Taken Report (ATR)
escalationSteps.action: The intermediary must redress the complaint and submit ATR to SEBI.

escalationSteps.title: Review by Designated Body / SMART ODR
escalationSteps.action: Escalate to Designated Body review or initiate online dispute resolution on SMART ODR.

forums.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (MHA)
forums.source: Ministry of Home Affairs & Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)

description.en: Official government portal for reporting financial cyber fraud, online investment scams, WhatsApp/Telegram phishing, and extortion.
description.hi: वित्तीय साइबर धोखाधड़ी, ऑनलाइन फर्जी निवेश योजनाओं, व्हाट्सएप/टेलीग्राम धोखाधड़ी की रिपोर्ट करने के लिए आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल।
description.mr: ऑनलाईन आर्थिक फसवणूक, बनावट गुंतवणूक योजना आणि टेलिग्राम/व्हॉट्सॲप घोटाळ्यांची तक्रार करण्यासाठी अधिकृत सरकारी पोर्टल.

applicableIssues: lost money to fake advisor on telegram or whatsapp
transferred money to personal upi id for stock tips
fake trading app showing fake profits but blocking withdrawals
blackmailed by loan app or fake trading group
requiredDocuments: Bank account statement showing debited transactions (UTR numbers)
Full screenshots of WhatsApp / Telegram chats showing promises and payment demands
Phone numbers, UPI handles, and website links of scammers
Transaction SMS receipts received from bank
Copy of PAN and Government Photo ID (Aadhaar/Voter ID)

escalationSteps.title: Immediately Call Cyber Helpline 1930
escalationSteps.action: Dial 1930 immediately to freeze fraudulent money before scammers withdraw it from beneficiary accounts.

escalationSteps.title: File Formal Complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
escalationSteps.action: Lodge complaint under 'Financial Fraud' with transaction IDs and bank account details.

escalationSteps.title: Visit Local Police Station Cyber Cell
escalationSteps.action: Carry acknowledgment slip from cybercrime.gov.in and bank statements to get formal FIR registered.

forums.name: Securities Market Online Dispute Resolution (SMART ODR)
forums.source: SEBI Master Circular for Online Dispute Resolution

description.en: SEBI-regulated online dispute resolution platform connecting investors with independent conciliators and arbitrators for securities disputes.
description.hi: प्रतिभूति बाजार में निवेशकों और मध्यस्थों के बीच स्वतंत्र मध्यस्थता के लिए सेबी-विनियमित ऑनलाइन मंच।
description.mr: गुंतवणूकदार आणि ब्रोकर्समधील वाद सोडवण्यासाठी सेबी-मान्यताप्राप्त ऑनलाईन लवादाचे (Arbitration) पोर्टल.

applicableIssues: dispute not resolved by broker or depository after 30 days
rejection of genuine claim by depository
requiredDocuments: Unique Client Code (UCC) with broker
Copy of complaint filed earlier with broker/exchange
Contract notes, bank statements, ledger proof
Summary of total claimed monetary loss

escalationSteps.title: File Dispute on SMART ODR
escalationSteps.action: Register at https://smartodr.in, select intermediary and submit claim.

escalationSteps.title: Conciliation Session
escalationSteps.action: Independent conciliator conducts virtual conciliation hearings between parties.

escalationSteps.title: Arbitration Award
escalationSteps.action: Independent arbitrator passes legally binding award enforceable in civil court.
